harbor_antrieb_executor.summary: Configured PostgreSQL 9.5 streaming replication across node1 (primary), node2 and node3 (read-only standbys) on Ubuntu 16.04. Installed postgresql/postgresql-contrib on all three nodes, created a replicator role on node1, configured wal_level/max_wal_senders/wal_keep_segments/hot_standby and pg_hba.conf for replication, took pg_basebackup snapshots to seed node2/node3, and configured recovery.conf in standby_mode on both. Verified data written on the primary (repl_test table) replicates to both standbys and that standbys reject writes (read-only). Then performed the mandatory sequential node-restart protocol (node2, node3, node1) using `shutdown -r now` backgrounded so acks returned before disconnection; confirmed each node's boot_id changed post-restart, confirmed PostgreSQL auto-started and standbys resumed streaming replication and retained data across restarts, and confirmed a post-primary-restart write again propagated to both standbys.
actions_performed: Inspected all 3 nodes (Ubuntu 16.04, no PostgreSQL initially)
apt-get update + install postgresql postgresql-contrib on node1, node2, node3 (PG 9.5)
Created replicator role with REPLICATION LOGIN on node1 primary

Configured postgresql.conf (listen_addresses=*, wal_level=hot_standby, max_wal_senders=10, wal_keep_segments=64) and pg_hba.conf (host replication entries for node2/node3 IPs) on node1, restarted postgresql
Stopped postgresql and cleared data dirs on node2/node3, ran pg_basebackup (stream mode) from node1 using secret_env for replication password
Configured recovery.conf (standby_mode=on, primary_conninfo, application_name) and hot_standby=on on node2/node3, started postgresql
Verified pg_stat_replication on node1 shows node2 and node3 streaming; confirmed pg_is_in_recovery()=t on standbys
Created repl_test table, inserted rows on primary, verified rows visible on both standbys, verified INSERT fails on standbys (read-only)
Removed temporary password file from node1
Captured pre-restart boot_id + health baseline on all 3 nodes

Sequentially restarted node2, then node3, then node1 (primary) via backgrounded 'shutdown -r now', polled each until reachable, verified changed boot_id, verified postgresql cluster status and replication/data recovery after each restart
After primary (node1) restart, verified both standbys reconnected to streaming state and a new write on primary propagated to both standbys

evidence.requirement: PostgreSQL installed and running on all 3 nodes
evidence.summary: postgresql-9.5 installed and pg_lsclusters/systemctl show 'online' on node1, node2, node3

evidence.requirement: node1 configured as primary with replication settings
evidence.summary: postgresql.conf shows wal_level=hot_standby, listen_addresses='*'; pg_hba.conf has replication entries for node2/node3

evidence.requirement: node2 and node3 configured as streaming standbys from node1
evidence.summary: pg_basebackup completed from node1; recovery.conf set standby_mode=on; pg_lsclusters shows 'online,recovery' on both

evidence.requirement: Primary and standby streaming replication link is active
evidence.summary: pg_stat_replication on node1 shows node2 and node3 in 'streaming' state; pg_is_in_recovery()=t on both standbys

evidence.requirement: Writes on primary are visible on both standbys; standbys are read-only
evidence.summary: Rows inserted on node1 (repl_test) appear identically on node2 and node3; INSERT attempts on both standbys fail with 'cannot execute INSERT in a read-only transaction'

evidence.requirement: node2 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id 74fd91b6...; reboot ack returned; SSH refused proving disconnect; reconnect confirms boot_id changed to f056935d...; postgresql online,recovery with data intact (count=2) and streaming resumed on node1

evidence.requirement: node3 restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id d08fb446...; reboot ack returned; SSH refused proving disconnect; reconnect confirms boot_id changed to 691591ce...; postgresql online,recovery with data intact (count=2); node1 confirms both standbys streaming before proceeding to primary restart

evidence.requirement: node1 (primary) restart: healthy baseline, restart ack, changed boot identity, recovered state and quorum
evidence.summary: Baseline boot_id dca72801...; reboot ack returned; SSH refused proving disconnect; reconnect confirms boot_id changed to 85cd9812...; postgresql back online as primary; pg_stat_replication shows both node2 and node3 reconnected streaming; new INSERT on primary verified present on both standbys, confirming full recovery of cluster and replication
